messages:
Maya Chen: FYI renewal for Novus is up next month. Contracted uptime 99.9% and p95 latency 200ms. Customer reported onboarding latency spikes, asking about potential credits. Need quick alignment on how we calculate and what we tell them.
James Ortiz: thanks. do we have logs / incident windows? any correlated infra notes? @kevin can you pull p95 for the last 30 days?
Kevin Li: pulling now, should have numbers in 10m. initial query shows a 12-minute window with elevated tail latency on 2025-11-12 UTC.
cs-monitor-bot: Automated report: Novus-prod - last30d: p50=45ms p95=210ms p99=580ms uptime=99.94% (total downtime 25m)
Elsa Park: Ok — if uptime is 99.94% that doesn't trigger SLA credit threshold (<99.9%). but tail latency >200ms might violate latency SLO depending on route. we need to map endpoints in contract.
Maya Chen: copy. @james can you confirm which endpoints Novus uses? they mainly call /generate and /embeddings via dedicated pool.
James Ortiz: confirmed: /generate for customer app, /embed for analytics. /generate accounts for ~85% of their tokens.
Kevin Li: here's quick calc I used for potential credit estimate:
```
credit_minutes = downtime_minutes
credit_pct = min(1.0, credit_minutes / (30*24*60))
estimate_credit_usd = credit_pct * monthly_commit
```
Using reported 25m downtime and monthly_commit=$12,000 -> credit ~= (25/(43200)) * 12000 = ~$6.94
Elsa Park: thanks — tiny amount but we should still log it. main ask is the latency regression. Can ops share an action plan for mitigations and a customer note draft?
Maya Chen: propose we: 1) confirm endpoint-level p95 for last 7d and 30d 2) run canary with quantized model fallback for /generate for 24h 3) draft customer note offering explanation + monitoring dashboard + small goodwill credit (if they ask).
James Ortiz: I'm happy to draft the customer-facing note. will include metrics, what we saw, and planned mitigations. pinging @elsa for approval.
Elsa Park: approve the outline. please include rollback/fallback options and expected ETA for fix (48-72h).
Kevin Li: I'll schedule the canary and attach the runbook. ETA to start: 1h. will post logs to the runbook and add a trace link.
Maya Chen: perfect. I'll schedule a brief sync with Novus for tomorrow 10am PT. James, have draft ready before EOD pls. tagging the renewal owner @elsa so we can record any impact on renewal decision.
James Ortiz: will share draft in this thread when ready. :thumbsup:
cs-monitor-bot: Runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/novus-latency-2912345678
Maya Chen: thanks team. action items: Kevin run canary, James draft note, Elsa approve comms, Maya schedule customer. follow up here once canary completes.
